researchNoteReplacements.Configuration areas include balconies an: Configuration areas include balconies and differ from rounded launch sizes. Tower D sheets show room dimensions. Complete A–D floorplate drawings are available in the floor-plan section. Detailed saleable areas for each numbered home remain unverified.

review.imagery: Thirty-eight own-project images were selected after visual review of all thirty current primary media assets, the complete eighty-two-page brochure index and twelve extracted native resources. Repeated courtyard/aerial images are excluded. Ten brochure scenes add bathrooms, kitchen/dining details, the gym, reading corner, loft and office reception. A separate orange-car texture is excluded. The original four-tower street view supplies the card and hero. Metro-bridge and surrounding-development renders retain proposed context.
review.floorPlans: All eighty-four complete first-phase floorplate sheets cover residential Towers A, B and C and office Tower D. The packet supplies each tower’s ground, selected podium levels, levels 1–15 and roof. Tower C starts at podium 2 and Tower D at podium 4. Their omitted podium drawings remain unavailable. Whole-home and office saleable totals and separate detailed unit-type sheets are absent. Confirm unit-specific areas, final layout, bridge access and the applicable source revision with Imtiaz. All eighty-four original sheets were visually reviewed on twenty-one complete-sheet contacts. The prior twenty-page Tower D packet was screened and all nineteen drawing sheets separately reviewed. Its Tower D geometry overlaps the combined packet, with visible shared-workspace labeling differences. The complete four-tower packet supplies a coherent selectable set. Both retrieved packets and undated revision uncertainty remain recorded. No second-phase layouts are transferred. Tower C podium 1 and Tower D podiums 1–3 are not invented.
review.location: The complete factbook page 4 map and all seven printed travel entries were visually reviewed. The first-phase whole-floorplate context shows the pedestrian metro bridge. Operation and completion are unverified. The current official primary names the project through a place-ID embed without explicit target coordinates, so camera-centre numbers are excluded. Downtown Jebel Ali follows the correct protected location and source text. The stale internal DLRC research-community label is excluded from the enhancement.
review.provenance: Current official project media and HTML have dated URL, bytes, dimensions and SHA256 receipts. The brochure/factbook and earlier Tower D packet are Mitchell’s broker mirrors. A newly retrieved eighty-four-page Aumera broker packet supplies all four towers. Its exact public link was observed in the project page and original bytes validated. Historical text research is preserved. An exact media-dependent display replacement updates its earlier residential-drawing availability note, while commercial and contractual uncertainties remain visible.

unavailable: Standalone detailed home-type sheets, exact home/office saleable totals and numbered-unit contracts, omitted podiums, source-revision chronology, certified metro-bridge opening, exact visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established.
